payload.body_you:
Your routine tells the truth before you do. The job may be possible, but not on five hours of sleep. The schedule may look organized, but only because every meal, break, and appointment has been treated like an inconvenience. You may be dependable, but that does not mean every unfinished responsibility belongs to you.

Build a day that still works when you are tired. Fewer scattered commitments. Clearer priorities. Enough time to eat, sleep, keep appointments, and deal with health concerns properly. Keep doing the work that is yours, but stop using your best day as the minimum standard for every day.
